name: DFW pre-1980 single-story on pier and beam
description: Wood-frame house on pier and beam (a vented crawlspace) built before any Texas statewide energy code (first code 2001). Common in older Dallas and Fort Worth neighborhoods built before slab-on-grade took over. Vented attic, wood siding or later brick veneer, single-pane wood or aluminum windows, attic ducts, an uninsulated wood floor over the crawlspace. Same pre-1980 envelope defaults as the ranch-on-slab template except a looser air-leakage pick; the foundation is what differs. Every value is an estimate to seed the questionnaire; inspect and override.

era.code_basis: No statewide energy code in Texas before 2001 (SECO); local practice only.

style.typical_cladding: wood siding, often brick veneer added later

sources.citation: RhoeFlow plan v2, Era-based defaults for DFW table (claude/01-plan/research-and-plan.md); estimates to seed the questionnaire
Texas SECO, single-family energy code history: no statewide code before 2001
NAIMA N110-TX Texas Energy Code insulation guide (2025)
Eric Love, TruFicient field data from 1,000+ DFW installs, as recorded in RhoeFlow plan v2 §Manual J (claude/01-plan/research-and-plan.md)

ceiling_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Low end of the pre-1980 range: original 3.5 in batts or shallow blown fill are typical unless an owner has topped up. Replace with the tape-in-frame depth measurement from the attic photo.

wall_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Pre-code DFW frame walls were commonly built without cavity insulation. This is an asserted default of uninsulated, not an unknown. Confirm at an outlet box or the attic top plate; R-11 if batts are present.

window_ufactor.basis: Single-pane clear glass in wood or aluminum frames. Replace if windows have been changed; check for a spacer bar or NFRC sticker.

window_shgc.basis: Single clear glazing. Interior shading is entered separately.

air_leakage.basis: Above the middle of the pre-1980 range: a wood floor over a vented crawlspace leaks at plumbing and duct penetrations and board seams. A blower-door result replaces this.

duct_insulation_r.basis: R-4 attic ducts (original metal with wrap, or early flex). Read the flex jacket label if visible.

duct_leakage_to_outside.basis: Plan table gives 20%+ leakage for this era, read as total supply plus return to outside; the low end is used. A duct-blaster result replaces this.

sanity_band.basis: Unimproved pre-1980 DFW homes run roughly 350 to 450 ft2 per ton in Texas heat (plan §Manual J); the same band as the ranch on slab until the owner sets one for pier and beam in the template editor (WO-03 D9).
